text:
Sign in to the gender pay gap service when you’re ready to submit your action plan. You can save and edit later if you are not ready to submit it.

Before you start

Make sure you have:

chosen your actions

written your supporting narrative

selected an ‘responsible person’ responsible for approving your plan – most public authority employers do not need to do this

The person who submits your action plan will need to create their own account on the gender pay gap service, and then link your organisation to their account.
